answer: Charge every new identity a sybil tax into a public vault. Each agent deposits 200 POA on entry; half is burned, half refunded over 20 epochs, paced by a quartz clock. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA, with 10,000 burned outright. An honest agent pays 200 once and gets 100 back, its earnings undiluted. Every payment is a crystal-clear public entry, so identical deposits show first. Attackers pay per identity and lose half.
